basis.file25_plan: Complete Public UI, Profile Timeline and Visual Experience — Final Harmonized Specification 2.0 plus governing addenda
basis.central_plan: Sabri Social Homeopathy Platform Definitive/Consolidated Governing Master Plan 2026
basis.method: Fresh twenty-scope plan-to-code and cross-file audit focused on timeline filtering/sorting/pagination accessibility, REST/SEO parity, pin governance, and current companion repository drift.

reviews.finding: Baseline main e35563b7f3d8ebf0acbbc80982b7bcf2e1b78c0a and exact-main CI run 1689 were frozen as repository/CI evidence only.
File 25 remains public visual/profile/timeline presentation owner; File 20 shell, File 21 publication, File 24 assurance and File 26 global search/ranking ownership remain intact.
Timeline_Service already accepted a provider filter internally, but public profile UI/renderer never exposed or forwarded it. Added bounded available-provider choices and renderer/UI wiring.
Plan-required year filtering was absent. Added strict 4-digit bounded year parsing in HTML and REST paths plus normalized-item filtering.
Plan-required language filtering was absent. Added bounded BCP47-like language validation and case-insensitive normalized-item filtering.
Plan-required topic filtering was absent. Added bounded plain-text topic input, safe parsing and exact case-insensitive normalized-item matching.
Only reverse-chronological latest ordering existed. Added governed latest/oldest ordering while preserving pin precedence.
The plan required a Corrections primary filter, but no filter existed. Added corrections projection filtering over corrected/retracted owner-authorized items without inventing a native content type.
Search and secondary filter forms did not explicitly preserve each other's state or owner preview state. Added bounded hidden-state preservation and page reset behavior.
Filtered empty results could falsely say that the profile had no public publications. Empty state now distinguishes no matches from no publications.
Pagination lacked the plan-required screen-reader result/page announcement. Added aria-live status with page and public item count.
REST timeline endpoints exposed only page/per_page/content_type, diverging from HTML filtering. Added provider/year/language/topic/sort/search validation and forwarding.
SEO noindex detection covered only type/search/page/preview and missed new secondary filters. Added provider/year/language/topic/sort coverage.
Explicit default query variants such as ?sort=latest could remain indexable duplicates. Added query-presence detection so any timeline refinement URL is noindex.

pin_weight could alter ordering without the plan-required audit reference, actor, reason, surface and start/end window. Added bounded internal pin audit provenance; unaudited/invalid pins fail closed to weight 0 without dropping the public item.

File 09 repository main advanced to cfc5f781a766330314dc98c42abeca0eb7786eba (runtime 1.3.0/schema 6/contract 1.1.0). Dependency evidence was refreshed; compatibility remains within the accepted family.
File 14 repository main advanced to 080e2198d84dfb7491bb0b75946e14a5fe118b91 (runtime 1.4.8/schema 10005). Dependency evidence was refreshed; compatibility remains within >=1.4.3 <1.5.0.
File 03 public profile/media ownership remains compatible; File 08 Appointment and File 17 Follow stay fail-closed where target-bound owner contracts are absent.
Shell, publication, authoring, private dashboard, assurance and global search/ranking ownership boundaries remain intact.

Current File 21 ProfileTimeline owner contract exposes approved WordPress posts. Richer planned timeline types require authoritative owner-native timeline providers/contracts; File 25 must not infer public approval from section-card adapters or foreign storage.
